qa: At what age can my child start?
Our nursery takes children from 2 years old. Primary 1 starts at 6, and JSS 1 usually at 11 or 12.
Is there an entrance assessment?
Yes, a short and friendly one in English and Mathematics. It helps us place your child in the right class; it is not a pass or fail test.
What are the school hours?
Lessons run from 7:45 am to 2:30 pm, Monday to Friday. After-school clubs end at 4 pm.
Which exams do pupils sit?
Senior pupils sit WAEC and NECO, and pupils who choose it can also take Cambridge IGCSE.
How can we visit the school?
Call the school office to book a tour on any weekday morning. We also hold an open day every term.

c.t: The answers families ask for most. Anything else, our office is happy to help.

qa: Can we pay fees in instalments?
Yes. School fees can be paid in two or three instalments each term, by bank transfer or online with Paystack.
Does the school run a bus?
Our buses cover four routes across the city each morning and afternoon. The office will tell you the stop nearest your home.
Is lunch provided?
A hot lunch is served every day and is included in the fees. Tell us about any allergy and the kitchen will plan around it.
Where do we buy the uniform?
The uniform and sportswear are sold at the school shop, open on weekdays from 8 am to 3 pm.

sections.name: Two sets of questions side by side

qa: When can my child join?
We admit pupils at the start of each term, and mid-term when a place is free.
What does the assessment cover?
English, Mathematics and a short chat with a teacher. It takes about an hour.
Which documents do we need?
A birth certificate, the last school report and two passport photographs.
How do we pay the fees?
By bank transfer, or online with a card or bank account through Paystack.
Can fees be split?
Yes, into up to three instalments a term. Speak to the bursar to set up a plan.
What does the uniform cost?
A full set is sold at the school shop. The price list is sent with every offer letter.

sections.name: Questions in a card on a soft band

qa: What if my child is sick?
Please keep them at home and call the school office before 8 am. Our school nurse cares for any child who falls ill during the day and calls you at once.
Which clubs run after school?
Football, music, coding, debate, art and the reading club, from 2:30 pm to 4 pm.
Do clubs cost extra?
Most clubs are free. A few, like swimming, have a small fee each term.
How will the school keep in touch?
Through the parents' app, a WhatsApp message for anything urgent, and a report at the end of every term.
From what age can pupils board?
Boarding is open from JSS 1, when most pupils are 11 or 12.
Can parents visit boarders?
Yes, on the first Saturday of every month, and on the open days each term.
Who looks after the boarders?
Each house has a housemother or housemaster who lives on site, with a nurse on call day and night.
How do we pay boarding fees?
Boarding fees are paid each term with the school fees, by bank transfer or Paystack.

c.alt: Pupils in the Greenfield boarding house

qa: How old must my child be for Primary 1?
Six years old by September of the year they start.
How do we apply?
Collect a form at the school office or apply online, then book the entrance assessment.
When are fees due?
Before the first day of each term, or in instalments agreed with the bursar.
Is there a discount for siblings?
Yes, 10% off the fees for a second child and 15% for a third.
When does school start?
The gates open at 7:15 am and lessons begin at 7:45 am.
Can my child stay late?
Yes, after-school clubs and supervised homework run until 4 pm.

sections.name: Questions on a dark band with a line to ask more

qa: Do pupils sit WAEC and NECO?
Yes. Every SS 3 pupil sits WAEC, and most also sit NECO in the same year.
Do you offer Cambridge exams?
Pupils can take Cambridge IGCSE in up to eight subjects, with extra classes on Saturdays.
How does the school prepare pupils?
Mock exams each term, Saturday revision classes and a study plan agreed with every pupil.

sections.name: Questions beside a card to reach us

qa: Which areas does the bus cover?
Our four routes run through the city centre and the main estates nearby. Ask the office for the route sheet.
How much is the bus each term?
The bus is paid each term with the school fees, and the price depends on your route.
What does lunch include?
A hot meal with rice, beans, yam or pasta, fruit and clean drinking water every day.
Is the school open in the holidays?
The office opens on weekday mornings, and a holiday camp runs for two weeks in August.

c.t: Our office answers from 7 am to 4 pm, Monday to Friday.
